## Findings

- [ ] F1 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Consistency.lean:20` — The source-linked consistency API omits probability, normalization, POVM, and opposite-tensor-factor constraints.
- [ ] F2 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/StrategyClasses.lean:102` — `Measurement.IsConsistentOn` and `IsConsistentStrategyOn` omit the source’s projectivity requirement.
- [ ] F3 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/StrategyClasses.lean:127` — `Strategy.IsPCC` accepts data unrelated to its `Strategy G` instead of using the game and strategy fields.
- [ ] F4 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean:55` — The square-root agreement estimate is false without state normalization and `μ.IsProbability`.
- [ ] F5 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean:87` — `fact:add-a-proj2` is restricted from an arbitrary function collection to the whole function space.
- [ ] F6 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean:129` — The consistency triangle estimate is false without state normalization and probability mass control.
- [ ] F7 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean:147` — Data processing is falsely generalized from opposite tensor factors to same-space noncommuting POVMs.
- [ ] F8 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean:163` — The purported universal commutator constant is scoped after the carrier types and may depend on them.
- [ ] F9 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:31` — `sandwichProduct` supplies individual matrices but omits the source conclusion that they form a POVM.
- [ ] F10 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:60` — The sandwich constant may depend on `k` and all carrier types, defeating the source’s explicit linear dependence on `k`.
- [ ] F11 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:66` — The sandwich theorem replaces each finite code family with the entire function space.
- [ ] F12 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:68` — The sandwich square-root estimate is false for an arbitrary unnormalized vector.
- [ ] F13 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:42` — `pastedMeasurement` omits the source assertion that the indexed products form a measurement.
- [ ] F14 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:117` — The pasting theorem replaces both arbitrary code collections with full function spaces.
- [ ] F15 (blocker) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Sandwich.lean:120` — Pasting introduces an independent projective `A'` absent from the source self-consistency premise.
- [ ] F16 (blocker) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:592` — `lem:twisted-commutation` is marked `\leanok` although its unitarity and spectral conclusions have no linked Lean declaration.
- [ ] F17 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SelfDualBasis.lean:18` — The basis-definition docstrings cite downsize and bit-representation passages instead of paper lines 494–502.
- [ ] F18 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:37` — The `lem:alnf`, `lem:dlnf`, and `def:ld-meas` docstrings point to unrelated paper ranges.

- [ ] F24 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/MagicSquareTheorems.lean:148` — The `Local fix` marker describes facts already stated in the canonical paper and should be removed or properly justified.

## Review

Changes are required because several source-linked statements are either false at their current generality or omit material parts of the cited results.

F1–F3 drift from `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:144-180,232-248`. The paper uses projective measurements or POVMs, normalized states, probability distributions, and the game’s actual strategy data. Raw generalized helpers may remain as Lean-only declarations, but the declarations linked with `\leanok` need paper-facing wrappers.

F4 and F6 fail by scaling. On a singleton question space with opposite deterministic binary measurements and `‖ψ‖ = N`, F4 reduces to `N² ≤ 2N`; F6 admits premises `ε = γ = 0`, `δ = N²` and the same false conclusion. The existing paper-faithful LDT theorem at `MIPStarRE/LDT/Preliminaries/Triangles/SimEq.lean:24` explicitly requires normalization and mass at most one.

F7 contradicts the source’s opposite-side setting at paper lines 397–401. Same-space coarse-graining can remove negative cross terms. `MIPStarRE/LDT/Preliminaries/ComparisonCore.lean:458-475` already documents this obstruction and provides the heterogeneous theorem.

F5, F11, and F14 lose the arbitrary finite function collections from paper lines 347–350, 466–478, and 504–516. The sandwich restriction is especially load-bearing: the full function space contains pairs differing at one point, so the required small-collision hypothesis generally fails. F9 and F13 also omit the POVM laws explicitly asserted at paper lines 484–493 and 514–523.

F8 and F10 place implicit type parameters, and in F10 `k`, outside the existential constant. This permits per-instance constants, contrary to the universal quantitative contract and `local/briefs/0016-orchestrator-task.md:83-87`.

F12 independently fails by scaling: for `k = 1`, the defect grows as `N²` while the stated right side grows only as `N`. F15 changes paper equation `eq:pasting-2`, which uses the same `A` on both tensor factors, into an assumption about an unrelated `A'`.

For F16, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1056-1095` and blueprint lines 603–605 conclude that each generalized Pauli observable is unitary with `p`-th-root eigenvalues. The four linked theorems state multiplication, powers, finite order, and twisted commutation only; finite order alone does not imply unitarity for an arbitrary complex matrix.

F17–F24 require documentation repair under the repository’s source-traceability and paper-gap policies. In particular, `lem:alnf` and `lem:dlnf` are at paper lines 243–257 and 261–272, `def:ld-meas` is at 394–408, and `def:line-point-dist` is at 274–287.

The exact-head CI result is green and `git diff --check` passes. I found no added axioms or kernel bypasses. I did not list the 70 added `sorry` sites individually because `local/briefs/42-residual-brief.md:200-219` explicitly designates these proposition-level obligations as marker-free Stage 4.2 skeleton debt; they remain the principal residual proof risk.
